result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: overlapping text on a restaurant card that makes delivery time unreadable.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text ('25-30') overlaps the word 'delivery', so the metadata line is garbled.
issues.suggestion: Give the time and fee labels enough space (wrap, truncate, or increase card padding) so they never collide.
